dissolutions/ch01.txt: Nothing did not lose to something. Nothing was never in the running.
dissolutions/ch02.txt: What exists is what has been written.
dissolutions/ch03.txt: Mind and matter were never two kinds of thing.
dissolutions/ch04.txt: Experience does not arise from anything. Experience is what the break is, from the inside.
dissolutions/ch05.txt: You are not a thing continuing through time. You are a pattern time is writing.
dissolutions/ch06.txt: There is one interior. The asking was always happening in it.
dissolutions/ch07.txt: You are not free of constraint. You are free within it. What you couple, you own.
dissolutions/ch08.txt: The is was never separated from the ought. There was one coupling. The reading is the work.
dissolutions/ch09.txt: Ethics was never an ungrounded domain. Its ground was one layer below where the tradition was looking.
dissolutions/ch10.txt: You are meaning happening, not meaning searching.
dissolutions/ch11.txt: Two readings of one now. No gap between them, because they were never two places.
dissolutions/ch12.txt: Coupling forces trajectories. The forcing is what observation is. Observer and observed are two readings of the one now.
resolutions/ch01.txt: Information is the record history, literally. The carrier is the carrying.
resolutions/ch02.txt: We did not invent mathematics. We read it off the structure we are made of.
resolutions/ch03.txt: Universals are not records. They are relations between records, and relations do not sit at sites.
resolutions/ch04.txt: The universe is the structure. The law is what we read when we examine what the structure does.
resolutions/ch05.txt: Causation is not glue between events. It is record-propagation at a bounded rate.
resolutions/ch06.txt: The continuum was the reading. The propagation was the running.
resolutions/ch07.txt: What persists is a pattern R holds continuous at a site.
resolutions/ch08.txt: Possibility does not need to be actualised somewhere else to be real. It is real as the openness of paths at the moment of choice.
resolutions/ch08_5.txt: The geometry is real. The override is real. The override is not the geometry.
resolutions/ch09.txt: Life is the first record-lineage that uses its own records to maintain, regenerate and propagate itself under selection.
resolutions/ch10.txt: The interior is one because the substrate is one. The experiences differ because the architectures differ.
resolutions/ch11.txt: The window closes at death. The interior does not.
resolutions/ch12.txt: The same break that opens the possibility of love opens the possibility of damage.
